Patch Set 3:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

The RHEL 8.10 version bump itself looks fine and is consistent across the target file, which_patch and both ChangeLog lists. The support-matrix rework that came with it is a separate concern though: the version bump is 2 ChangeLog lines, the rework is another 111 added / 69 removed, and it only appeared in patchset 3 after the change had already been reviewed and +1'd as a routine kernel bump. Would it be better as its own change with its own ticket, so the matrix edits get reviewed on their own merits and this one stays a trivial bump?

commit.message:
LU-20474 kernel: update RHEL 8.10 [4.18.0-553.155.1.el8_10]

Update RHEL 8.10 kernel to 4.18.0-553.155.1.el8_10.

The patch also does three more things:
- adds distro group headings throughout the 2.18.0 block
- adds the missing RHEL 10.0 entry to the server primary list
- moves SLES15 SP5, SLES15 SP6 and Ubuntu 22.04 out of the
  client primary list into "Other clients known to build ..."
